title: Browse Gyms & Fitness TV Commercials & TV Ads - iSpot

facts.fact: The Gyms & Fitness category page on iSpot lists Orangetheory Fitness as a featured brand.
iSpot promotes a Q3 report that covers the ads, spenders, and trends that defined Q3.
facts.quote: See the ads, spenders, and trends that defined Q3. [Get the Report>]

facts.fact: A Planet Fitness Spanish-language TV spot is titled 'Hazte más fuerte: $15 dólares al mes', advertising a $15 per month price.
facts.quote: Planet Fitness TV Spot, 'Hazte más fuerte: $15 dólares al mes' [Spanish]

facts.fact: A Planet Fitness New Year TV spot is titled 'Año Nuevo: fuerza: $1 dólar de pago inicial', advertising a $1 initial payment.
facts.quote: Planet Fitness TV Spot, 'Año Nuevo: fuerza: $1 dólar de pago inicial' [Spanish]

facts.fact: A BODi Black Friday TV spot is titled 'You Promised Yourself: Save Up to 75%', promoting discounts of up to 75%.
facts.quote: BODi Black Friday Sale TV Spot, 'You Promised Yourself: Save Up to 75%'

facts.fact: iSpot's case study headline states that Mattress Firm hit a 51% purchase intent rate (iSpot-reported result, not a third-party figure).
facts.quote: How Mattress Firm Hit a 51% Purchase Intent Rate and Turned Around ROAS

facts.fact: The page describes TV commercials as typically 30-second videos that air during breaks in programming.
facts.quote: TV commercials, sometimes referred to as TV ads or TV advertisements, are short, typically 30-second videos

facts.fact: iSpot states its National TV Ad Occurrence Reporting is accredited by the Media Rating Council (MRC).
facts.quote: National TV Ad Occurrence Reporting Accredited by Media Rating Council (MRC)
